panels.title: Run catalog
panels.description: One row per Run ID, newest first. All filtered Run IDs are shown in one scrollable table. The separate command panel includes the same filtered Run IDs.

targets.query:
import "strings"

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "wtt_k6_summary" and
    r.warmup == "false" and
    (r._field == "tls_version" or
      r._field == "key_exchange_group" or
      r._field == "key_exchange_group_source")
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.wtt_run_id =~ /^${wtt_run_id:regex}$/ and
    r.wtt_scenario =~ /^${wtt_scenario:regex}$/ and
    r.wtt_stack =~ /^${wtt_stack:regex}$/ and
    r.wtt_profile =~ /^${wtt_profile:regex}$/
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with
    wtt_run_name:
      if exists r.wtt_run_name then r.wtt_run_name else "-"
  }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.wtt_run_name =~ /^${wtt_run_name:regex}$/)
  |> pivot(
    rowKey: [
      "_time", "wtt_run_id", "wtt_run_name", "wtt_scenario", "wtt_stack",
      "wtt_profile", "wtt_execution_index", "cell",
    ],
    columnKey: ["_field"],
    valueColumn: "_value",
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with
    tls_version_filter: if exists r.tls_version then r.tls_version else "-",
    tls_group_filter:
      if exists r.key_exchange_group_source and
        r.key_exchange_group_source == "openssl-preflight"
      then r.key_exchange_group
      else if exists r.key_exchange_group_source and
        r.key_exchange_group_source == "not-applicable"
      then "none"
      else "unverified",
  }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.tls_version_filter =~ /^${tls_version:regex}$/ and
    r.tls_group_filter =~ /^${tls_group:regex}$/
  )

  |> group(columns: ["wtt_run_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time", "cell"])
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    Timestamp: string(v: r._time),
    RunName: if exists r.wtt_run_name then r.wtt_run_name else "-",
    RunID: r.wtt_run_id,
    Scenario: r.wtt_scenario,
    Stack: r.wtt_stack,
    Workloads:
      if strings.containsStr(v: r.wtt_run_id, substr: "-blog_tls_baseline-")
      then "Baseline: Linear, Flat, Sine"
      else if strings.containsStr(v: r.wtt_run_id, substr: "-blog_tls_linear_peak-")
      then "High-pressure linear: Fixed 100 VUs, Expandable to 1,000 VUs"
      else if strings.containsStr(v: r.wtt_run_id, substr: "-blog_tls_race-")
      then "Race: 10, 100, 1,000 VUs"
      else r.wtt_profile,
    TLS: r.tls_version_filter,
    TLSGroup: r.tls_group_filter,
  }))

panels.title: Export all filtered Run IDs
panels.description: Copy the Command cell. It joins every distinct Run ID matching the active filters and ignores the catalog page.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "wtt_k6_summary" and
    r.warmup == "false" and
    (r._field == "tls_version" or
      r._field == "key_exchange_group" or
      r._field == "key_exchange_group_source")
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.wtt_run_id =~ /^${wtt_run_id:regex}$/ and
    r.wtt_scenario =~ /^${wtt_scenario:regex}$/ and
    r.wtt_stack =~ /^${wtt_stack:regex}$/ and
    r.wtt_profile =~ /^${wtt_profile:regex}$/
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with
    wtt_run_name:
      if exists r.wtt_run_name then r.wtt_run_name else "-"
  }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.wtt_run_name =~ /^${wtt_run_name:regex}$/)
  |> pivot(
    rowKey: [
      "_time", "wtt_run_id", "wtt_run_name", "wtt_scenario", "wtt_stack",
      "wtt_profile", "wtt_execution_index", "cell",
    ],
    columnKey: ["_field"],
    valueColumn: "_value",
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with
    tls_version_filter: if exists r.tls_version then r.tls_version else "-",
    tls_group_filter:
      if exists r.key_exchange_group_source and
        r.key_exchange_group_source == "openssl-preflight"
      then r.key_exchange_group
      else if exists r.key_exchange_group_source and
        r.key_exchange_group_source == "not-applicable"
      then "none"
      else "unverified",
  }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.tls_version_filter =~ /^${tls_version:regex}$/ and
    r.tls_group_filter =~ /^${tls_group:regex}$/
  )

  |> group(columns: ["wtt_run_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time", "cell"])
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["wtt_run_id"])
  |> reduce(
    identity: {
      Command: "python3 analyze/exporting/export-tls-result-svgs.py",
      Runs: 0,
    },
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      Command: accumulator.Command + " \\\n  --run-ids " +
        "wttperfacrkhmsb6.azurecr.io/wtt/benchmark-results:" + r.wtt_run_id,
      Runs: accumulator.Runs + 1,
    }),
  )
